name: How long does brown water last?

mainEntity.name: How long does brown water last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of brown water depends on its cause. If it's due to a localized event like fire hydrant flushing or a minor disturbance in the water main, it typically clears up within a few hours after running your faucets. If the issue stems from a significant water main break or work on the municipal system, it could take longer, sometimes up to 24-48 hours. If the problem is internal to your home, such as corroded pipes, the brown water may reoccur frequently until the underlying issue is addressed by a plumber.
acceptedAnswer.description: Brown water usually clears within a few hours to a day, but can persist longer if due to major utility work or internal pipe issues.
